archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 2 METRICS of AGENTS.md: read every code before it goes in a rule
question: How is this code read: its meaning, unit, scope, step, window, status, what empty means and what it must never be read as?
usage_from_code: python3 -B metric_brief_v2.py C2.S04 A1.S01 ...      exact codes

commands.name: brief
commands.does: prints the brief of each code named (or of every code matching --grep or of a --family) from the four tables of this Alarm folder

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: optional: this machine's settings file, checked by _tools/settings_v1.py (the tool reads no data with it); a missing or refused file is refused, exit 2

args.name: exact codes
args.meaning: one or more exact codes, e.g. A1.S08 E2.S04

args.name: --grep
args.meaning: every code whose code, name or meaning holds these words (long: funding prints about 800 lines)

args.name: --family
args.meaning: every code of one family, e.g. A4

commands.writes: nothing: it prints the briefs (read only)

refuses.when: REFUSED: a settings file that is missing or refused, a table missing from this Alarm folder, a run outside an Alarm folder; an unknown option prints the usage

rules: read only: four tables inside this Alarm folder (METRICS_V1, METRIC_TRAPS_V3, the CTX and EPI catalogues); no market data
a STOP, RULE or CAUTION line under the code, or a status that is not PROVEN, is the detector gate word: STOP, CAUTION and UNPROVEN codes are refused in a rule

it does not read the tables the COUNT job gate adds (the owner-cleared Hyperliquid rows of LEAD/loop2/defs): a code it calls NOT FOUND may still pass the COUNT gate, X1.HLFLOWX.S08 and S09 do (DEF_TEMPLATE_V4.md, The metric gate; R7 F35)
an unknown code prints a NOT FOUND line with exit 0: read the output, not only the exit
its LAST DAY is the card's, not where the data ends: read the data's end from a COUNT by month (playbook, What fails)

outputs.file: printed: a brief (a header line, then LABEL: value lines)

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the planted folder; the tables are this Alarm folder's own
